title: Cohomology and multiplicative gaps for quasi-isometries of nilpotent groups
summary: We construct two word metrics on the same seven-dimensional torsion-free nilpotent lattice whose asymptotic cones are isometric, but for which every quasi-isometry has multiplicative constant at least $1+\varepsilon$, for one fixed $\varepsilon>0$. We use a convex invariant of a fixed quasi-isometry $Ψ:N\to M$. The displacement cocycle of $Ψ$ and the right-invariant means on $N$ determine a compact convex set $\mathcal A(Ψ)\subseteq\operatorname{Hom}(V_N,V_M)$.
